$comment: Issue-routing registry for zheref/Ztyle (this product repository) and the tool repositories it consumes. Authored at Hatsu adoption on 2026-10-22 from the owner's answers: kind product, role consumer, gate G2 (the maintainer's ruling of 2026-09-18 that the gate is the repository's role, not the file's kind). No remote existed at adoption; at bootstrap on 2026-10-23 the slug was set to GitHub's canonical case, zheref/Ztyle (public), and the pins set to the latest released tags (Hatsu v0.130.0, bankai-handbooks v0.11.0, nen v0.26.0). The consumer row carries no `scenario` on purpose: bankai-handbooks v0.11.0 has no Gatsby/static-React scenario, so no stack handbook resolves and stack-prefixed checks stay unread until the owner rules whether react-uzf-v1 governs it or a scenario is added (a G4 handbook-question). `product_codes` carries no nested `$comment`: nen's repos loader reads every key of that map as a code.

consumers.role: Ztyle, a Gatsby wardrobe planner -- the product this registry belongs to

maintained_tools.role: Canonical handbooks and constitution (CON-13) -- read at this pin; port.handbooksRepo names it
